# nanoflags_segment (Resource)

A reusable audience, referenced from rules with the `segment` / `not_segment` operators. Segments are project-wide: they are part of every environment's draft and reach SDKs with the next publish. Deleting a segment makes rules that still reference it match nobody.

Scopes: `segments:read`, `segments:write`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nanoflags_segment" "pro_customers" {
  project     = "web"
  key         = "pro-customers"
  name        = "Pro customers"
  description = "Paying customers on Pro or Team"
  match       = "all"

  condition {
    attribute = "plan"
    op        = "in"
    value     = jsonencode(["pro", "team"])
  }
  condition {
    attribute = "country"
    op        = "not_in"
    value     = jsonencode(["XX"])
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Segment key, e.g. `beta-users`. Immutable.
- `project` (String) Project key or id.

### Optional

- `condition` (Block List) A targeting condition. All or any conditions must hold, depending on `match`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--condition))
- `description` (String) Description.
- `match` (String) `all` (default) or `any` of the conditions.
- `name` (String) Display name. Defaults to the key.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time.
- `id` (String) Segment id (UUID).
- `updated_at` (String) Last change.

<a id="nestedblock--condition"></a>
### Nested Schema for `condition`

Required:

- `op` (String) Operator: `eq`, `neq`, `in`, `not_in`, `contains`, `starts_with`, `ends_with`, `gt`, `gte`, `lt`, `lte` (numbers), `semver_eq`, `semver_neq`, `semver_gt`, `semver_gte`, `semver_lt`, `semver_lte` (semantic versions such as `4.10.0`), `before`, `after` (dates: `2026-12-31`, `2026-12-31T09:00:00Z` or a Unix timestamp), `exists`, `not_exists`, `segment`, `not_segment`. SDK releases from before the version and date operators evaluate those conditions as not matching.

Optional:

- `attribute` (String) Context attribute, e.g. `plan` or `key`. Ignored (leave empty) for the `segment` and `not_segment` operators.
- `value` (String) JSON-encoded comparison value, e.g. `jsonencode(["pro", "team"])` for `in`, or `jsonencode("beta-users")` (a segment key) for `segment`. Omit for `exists` / `not_exists`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <project key>/<segment key>
terraform import nanoflags_segment.pro_customers web/pro-customers
```
